_about: Your own phrases for the evals, alongside evals/references.json. Each sentence has an id, its English (en) and translations you trust, by the app's language code; a language left out is skipped for that sentence. For example: {"id": "own-1", "en": "Where is the train station?", "translations": {"fr": "Où est la gare ?", "de": "Wo ist der Bahnhof?"}}
